summary: Phase 7B tested (no calls were placed). Backend: a new test file test_ai_calling_phase7b_api.py with 16 tests runs against the public URL, all passing. The scratch-DB tests in test_ai_calling_phase7b.py also pass (8). The full AI-calling regression suite, excluding provider_phase31 and run with -n0, gave 234 passed and 14 skipped. Frontend, with the booking and consent APIs mocked through page.route: the booking page consent checkbox starts unchecked and shows the v2 wording. Booking with it unchecked sends granted:false, and booking with it checked sends granted:true. Both send text_version 2026-06-v2 and source booking_form, and the booking body is unchanged. Both reach schedule-success with ai-consent-outcome and manage-ai-consent-link (/ai-consent/:token). When the consent POST is mocked to return 503, the success screen still appears along with ai-consent-failed. On the consent page, the status shows; withdraw goes from granted to withdrawn; the grant button is disabled until the box is checked, then saving goes back to granted with source consent_page; a mocked 404 shows ai-consent-error. Admin UI: the Live Mode synthetic and real tabs work. The synthetic planner ran (15 bookings). The real tab shows the warning, the run button and the empty message (0 bookings, read-only). The Settings page shows live-limits '20 calls/day · 1 at a time', a disabled live-authorize-btn and live-dispatch-status OFF. The history page shows the Phase 4B Raj call.

minor.issue: The storage description lists the fields 'status (granted|refused|withdrawn)', 'consent_at' and 'withdrawn_at'. The documents actually stored use consent_status (granted|not_given|withdrawn), consent_timestamp and consent_withdrawn_at. The description is out of date.
The blocker text still reads 'Live dispatch is not implemented yet (Phase 7A)'. The phase label is out of date.

issues: The live-locked-banner says 'No real candidate is read or called in this phase', but the new Real Bookings tab does read bb_registrations (read-only). The wording should be updated.
The page has no Blubridge header logo or footer, unlike the booking page it is linked from. Candidates may not trust an unbranded page.
The live limits are display-only. There are no inputs in Limits & defaults, so they can only be edited through the API. This is fine if intended.
The disabled 'Authorize Live Dispatch (disabled)' button is pink text on a pink background with very low contrast (intentionally disabled).

action_items: Consider what happens on a reschedule: a candidate who already granted consent sees the checkbox unchecked by default, and rebooking then silently overwrites 'granted' with 'not_given' (and cancels their pending live jobs). Either pre-check or label the current status, or skip the POST when the box is unchecked and consent was already granted.
Update the out-of-date text: 'Phase 7A' in the live blockers, the Live Mode banner sentence about no real candidate being read, and the consent/preview storage field names.

Optional: hardcode text_version '2026-06-v2' or fall back to it. If the consent GET fails on page load, the checkbox stays disabled and the POST sends undefined, which always returns 409 and shows the 'failed' state.
critical_code_review_comments: consent.py record_consent: for status 'not_given', consent_withdrawn_at from an earlier withdrawal is not cleared. This is minor.
The public consent endpoints have no rate limiting. The tokens carry 64 bits of entropy and require at least 16 characters, so enumeration risk is low.

Safety confirmed: authorize_live always raises 423 after writing an audit entry; real_preview only reads; withdrawal only updates live pending jobs with the exact registration_id and never touches bb_registrations.

Expected side effects: new ai_call_audit rows (authorize attempts and switch toggles from the 7A regression), mode_version moved from 67 to 71, and live_daily_call_limit/live_max_concurrent_calls are now explicitly saved as 20/1 (before they were unset and defaulted to the same values).
